messages:
Sam: Hey everyone — Sam here, first day! Quick Q: who owns infra/network access vs. oncall vs. platform so I know who to ping for VPN/MFA, deploy perms, and high-sev alerts? Also stuck on the SSO invite (403).

Maya: welcome Sam :tada: People Ops handles laptop + account invites. For VPN/MFA we loop in IT — ping @it-support. Onboarding doc: https://redwood.work/onboarding (contains owners + links).

it-support: Hi Sam — IT Support here. Sorry for the delay. Can you paste the exact error message and the SSO invite link? Quick tip: try clearing cookies or incognito while we look.

Sam: error text pasted: "403 Forbidden — SSO token invalid" and invite link DM'd.

Priya: hey Sam — eng-infra owns repo perms, deploy keys, and infra IAM. For access requests use the infra access form: https://redwood.work/infra-requests and tag @priya. If you need immediate deploy access for pairing, tell us in-thread.

Carlos: hi Sam — I'm your manager on the inference team, welcome! Ownership summary from product side: Eng Infra = infra & deploys, Eng Platform = runtime/build tooling (I usually mention @jordan for platform), Eng SRE = runtime oncall and paging. Escalation path for incidents: pager -> eng-sre -> eng-infra -> eng-platform -> manager. Runbook: /handbooks/oncall.

Leo: security note — for secrets/KMS or any prod access that touches customer data, use the security review workflow and cc security. If it's urgent, DM me and I'll prioritize.

Maya: TL;DR for your first-week cheat sheet: laptop/account -> people-ops; VPN/MFA -> it-support; repo/deploys -> eng-infra; runtime oncall -> eng-sre; security/KMS -> security. If any request stalls >1 business day, escalate to People Ops + your manager. I'll update the onboarding doc with these bullets.

Sam: perfect, that's exactly what I needed. One more: who owns billing/quotas for Dedicated customers (if I need a compute bump)?

Carlos: billing/commits/contract changes handled by Sales + Finance. For technical quota/compute increases, open an internal support ticket (/support) and cc eng-platform; we'll coordinate with Sales if it affects customer contracts.

Maya: I'll schedule a 15-min sync later today to walk through the checklist and add these ownership links to the doc. Also: @Sam you should get a calendar invite shortly.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: New Hire checklist due — 6 items left. Link: https://redwood.work/checklist :memo:

Sam: thanks everyone :rocket: saved this thread for reference.
